observed_and_source_required_result.reason: RFC 8949 well-formedness permits the two-byte simple-value form only when the following byte is at least 0x20; f8 18 is therefore malformed.

resolution.reason: Simple value 32 is the minimized well-formed two-byte unsupported simple value and preserves the original test purpose.

nonclaim: The correction changes one malformed conformance input; it does not broaden the accepted semantic value set or derive expectations from an implementation output.
